learning_outcomes.text: Write, run and debug small Python programs using the standard toolchain
Use Python's primitive types, literals and operators correctly
Convert between types and explain Python's expression-evaluation rules
Control program flow with conditionals and loops
Decompose a task into functions with clear parameters and return values
Read error messages and fix common beginner mistakes in Python

integrative_case: A beginner must build a small command-line Python program that reads input, validates it with conditionals, computes a result inside functions, and prints a formatted report, fixing each error the toolchain reports along the way.
